stage_order: T7.3a separator discovery (DEV only) + Policy Amendment Freeze
T7.3b VAL->CONF validation of frozen candidates
policy_lock: T7 MUST NOT modify E0-E3 / C-states / operators / P1-P3; T7.0-T7.4 operator source diff must stay empty; T7.5 counterfactual only; T7A=timing only (P2_balanced fixed), sizing deferred to T7B.

segment_protocol.t7_1: all segments, descriptive only, no candidate selection
segment_protocol.t7_3a: development only (discovery); output = frozen candidate list
segment_protocol.policy_amendment_freeze: contract amendment commit BEFORE any VAL/CONF validation product exists
segment_protocol.t7_3b: validation then confirmation (validate frozen candidates; failures recorded NOT_VALIDATED, no DEV re-selection)
segment_protocol.t7_4: all segments (independent preregistration, no policy derivation)

anchors.R0: identical to frozen T6.2 recycling R0 definition (consecutive-REDUCE fold-forward); anchor set must equal T6.2 cycle set (G8)
anchors.rule: trajectory information at R+10 and beyond is outcome/description only and may not enter primary ADD decision-rule derivation

factlayer_isolation.rule: the features builder never imports/reads the outcomes table (dependency-graph scan in gate); outcome builder may read path_fact
factlayer_isolation.sector_sidecar: t7_0_sector_sidecar.parquet — QUASI-PIT (2026-09-21 membership backfill), EXPLORATORY ONLY, physically separate file, forbidden in C/D policy families and in any primary claim

variable_semantics.max_bounce_Rk: max close-to-close log bounce within R+1..R+k vs R0 close (close_adj)
variable_semantics.consec_up_days_Rk: consecutive ret_1d_log>0 days as of R+k
variable_semantics.vol_load@maxbounce_R5: volume_load_vs_prebreak on the max-bounce day within R+1..R+5 (T6 frozen volume semantics)
variable_semantics.turnover@maxbounce_R5: turnover_load_3d_mean on the same max-bounce day (T6.3 signature source)
variable_semantics.consec_shrink_days_Rk: consecutive volume_load_vs_prebreak<1 days as of R+k
variable_semantics.eff_pos_share_Rk: share of efficiency_signed_3>0 days within R+1..R+k
variable_semantics.new_high_after_R0_Rk: 1 if drawdown_from_peak_log==0 on any day in R+1..R+k (at prior peak)

trajectory_features.threshold_free: continuous features carry no internal thresholds (0/1 literals exempt)

hotbounce_strata.clock: all three share the same decision clock: the max-bounce day within R+1..R+5
hotbounce_strata.bins: development-segment tertiles, frozen in this contract before any VAL/CONF application; no grid search

f6_taxonomy.mandatory_residual: F6p (unclassified share accepted at any level; no post-hoc residual splitting)
f6_taxonomy.lock: taxonomy frozen before reading any F6 outcome distribution (sha+time-order gate)

policy_families.B_delay: delay ADD by N=3 effective trading days (primary); N in {1,2,3,5} reported as curve
policy_families.C_repair_confirmation: derived policy: DEV-only discovery -> Policy Amendment Freeze -> VAL/CONF validation; FORBIDDEN to reference sector variables
policy_families.D_hotbounce_veto: veto/delay ADD when hot-bounce stratum (bounce x volume x turnover tertiles) hits the preregistered cell; FORBIDDEN to reference sector variables
policy_families.matched_diff_wording: paired counterfactual difference of complete policy paths within the same cycle — NOT a local treatment effect of a single ADD (exposure paths diverge after the first differing ADD decision)

adverse_excursion.rule: severe_dd_depth_log inherited verbatim from t6_contract preregistered_thresholds

statistics_prereg.rng: SeedSequence substreams; each T7 stage registers its enums in its stage gate before first run

claim_rules.association_not_prediction: separator claims must read "associated with subsequent path", never "predicts/identifies"
claim_rules.policy_two_axis: policy claims must report both false-ADD axis and missed-recovery axis; single-axis statements forbidden
claim_rules.derived_policy_label: C-family claims must carry "derived policy (DEV-only derivation, Policy Amendment Freeze <sha>)"
claim_rules.sector_quasi_pit: sector claims forced EXPLORATORY with backfill-bias annotation; unavailability is not evidence of absence
claim_rules.counterfactual_bound: T7.5 conclusions must carry the same-price-clock/same-cost qualifier

counterfactual_conservation.pre_add_bitwise: pre-ADD daily state sequences of all policy variants must be bitwise identical (divergence only after differing ADD decisions)
counterfactual_conservation.policy_specific_outcome_clock_audit: False-ADD W10 runs from each policy's own add day; Missed Recovery runs from the cycle/opportunity clock; mixing them is a gate failure

reference_policy.name: A
reference_policy.role: frozen reference (current policy); NOT replaced by any DEV-discovered rule

primary_amendment_candidate.name: C1
primary_amendment_candidate.threshold_source: DEV tertile q1 (t7_2_bins.json, frozen at c2795d7)
primary_amendment_candidate.decision_clock: R+5 (max_bounce_R5 fully observable only at R+5)
primary_amendment_candidate.rule: After R0, no immediate re-ADD. Observe through R+5. If max_bounce_R5 > threshold -> ADD eligible. If max_bounce_R5 <= threshold -> no further ADD this cycle.
primary_amendment_candidate.interpretation: risk-reduction amendment candidate; NOT an expected-return enhancement, NOT a new primary winner

secondary_sensitivity.name: C2
secondary_sensitivity.rule: same semantics as C1 with threshold q2
secondary_sensitivity.constraint: C2 may NEVER be promoted to primary after seeing VAL/CONF results; sensitivity reporting only

d_family.name: D
d_family.reason: DEV discovery shows higher bounce -> LOWER FR rate (hi tertile FR 32.3% vs lo 62.1%): the original hot-bounce veto direction is unsupported. Registering an evidence-free rule is forbidden; an empty family is itself a research result.

utility.evaluation: 2D frontier: x = false-ADD risk reduction, y = recovery upside captured/missed; secondary panels: capital efficiency / drawdown / exposure. The A-vs-C1 trade-off is reported, not forced into a single winner.

provenance.ancestry_assertion: this Freeze precedes any VAL/CONF policy evaluation artifact; verified by git history order

t7_4_f6_taxonomy.order_semantics: classification precedence, NOT a risk ranking

common_fields.censored_rule: censored mark loss counts for D1/D3/D5 eligibility but is reported separately (completed vs censored panels)

D4_sudden_break.pre_break_dd_rule: episode max DD before the break day remains non-severe (dd_log > -0.1053605156578263)

D2_late_false_recovery.clock: same frozen false-recovery failure condition as T6.3 F3; FIRST occurs at effective-observation offset > 5 after A0; MUST be actually observed within the episode horizon (censoring is not late failure)
D2_late_false_recovery.f3_boundary: failure_offset <= 5 -> already F3 (T6.3 frozen); failure_offset > 5 -> D2-eligible within F6 input set; not observed -> not D2

F6'_mandatory_residual.note: large residual is NOT failure; GOOD-heavy F6' may show the existing failure taxonomy has no reason to call these episodes failures. T7.4 success is NOT measured by a low residual rate. No threshold retuning after seeing the distribution.

gate_additions.G34_component_provenance_replay: every condition variable (cycle count, endpoint return, exposure occupancy, pre-break DD, single-day return, D2 failure clock) independently replayed from frozen T6/T7 facts; runner-side ad-hoc recomputation of near-equivalent versions is forbidden

provenance.design_commit: b76d653 (v1) + ratified v2 in freeze commit
provenance.ancestry_assertion: this taxonomy freeze precedes any F6 outcome distribution read / t7_4 product; verifiable by git history order
